# Append Validation — appending to a page runs the write-time validation pipeline

# A page is validated as the append leaves it: an append whose result breaks a
# template rule reports every failed rule, fails the command and leaves the page
# byte-identical. The valid append path keeps its output line, and a page
# without a type can no longer be appended to.

exec akb init append-validation-kb
cd append-validation-kb

# --- A valid ADR page ---
stdin ../adr-input.md
exec akb write append-adr.md
stdout 'Written to kb/decisions/append-adr.md'

# --- The valid append path is unchanged ---
stdin ../appendix.txt
exec akb append decisions/append-adr.md
stdout 'Appended to kb/decisions/append-adr.md'

# --- An append whose result breaks two rules reports both and fails ---
cp kb/decisions/append-adr.md ../adr-before-failed-append.md
stdin ../options-appendix.txt
! exec akb append decisions/append-adr.md
stderr 'disallow_options'
stderr 'page must not have a .## Options. heading'
stderr 'disallow_pros_cons'
stderr 'page must not have a .## Pros and Cons. heading'

# The failed append left the page as it was
cmp ../adr-before-failed-append.md kb/decisions/append-adr.md

# --- A page without a type cannot be appended to ---
mkdir kb/notes
cp ../typeless-page.md kb/notes/typeless.md
stdin ../appendix.txt
! exec akb append notes/typeless.md
stderr 'validate type: missing required field .type. in frontmatter'
cmp ../typeless-page.md kb/notes/typeless.md

-- adr-input.md --
---
type: adr
title: Append Validation ADR
summary: ADR for append validation
tags: test
status: proposed
deciders: team
created: '2020-01-01'
updated: '2020-01-01'
---
## Context

Context body.

## Decision

Decision body.

## Consequences

Consequences body.

-- appendix.txt --
Appended body line.

-- options-appendix.txt --
## Options

Option A.

## Pros and Cons

Pros and cons.

-- typeless-page.md --

---
